question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

 APT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Suitable)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"APT"** means something that is appropriate, suitable, or fitting for a particular situation. (उपयुक्त)
 
 
• **Example: **His comments were apt for the occasion and resonated well with the audience.
 
 

 
• **"Suitable"** refers to something that is right or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation. (उपयुक्त)
 
 
• **Example: **She wore a suitable outfit for the formal event.
